items.title: Final Fantasy 14: Evercold sets itself a release date at the tail end of winter, alongside offering a look at its second, avian-inclined new job
items.summary: And it's coming slightly later than expected.
items.content:
Image credit: Square Enix News by Oisin Kuhnke Contributor Published on Nov. 1, 2026, 6:07 p.m. 1 comment Follow Final Fantasy XIV: A Realm Reborn - Collector's Edition Let's start with the bad news: Final Fantasy 14: Evercold has been delayed. The good news, that doesn't matter all that much, as it's only a delay of roughly a month, and a release date has been set in stone too: February 23rd, 2027. It's cutting it a bit close to the seasons shifting towards spring, making the game seasonally inappropriate, but hey ho, February is still winter!

That release date was revealed during this week's Final Fantasy 14 Fest Fest held in Tokyo. It was paired with a big ole cinematic that'll open up the expansion when you do actually get to play it. You can watch that down below if you fancy, that'll just depend on whether you want to go into the expansion knowing as little as possible. Looks pretty at least! I like the big dragony ship we've seen previously .

The expansion's second new job has been revealed too. It's called Zephyr, a physical ranged DPS that uses a crossbow and comes with its own avian familiar to assist you in battle. Seems like a pretty good option for folks afraid of getting in close but want to get some damage in. The bird friend you get is neat too. I hereby request that every other job gets a bird friend! I don't care if it doesn't make sense!

Most annoyingly, for me personally as someone that's only managed to play A Realm Reborn and doesn't really have time to go through a ridiculous number of hours and expansions just to get to this one, a preview for the Evangelion collab alliance raid was shown off rendered in the style of the original anime's post-credits, next episode teaser reels . I love those dang big robots and feelings of depression, don't make me go through all those expansions just to let my Viera dress up as Asuka or whatever loot you end up getting.

Anyway, don't forget to mark your calendars, February 23rd! Be there or be, uh, anywhere else I guess. I'm not your boss.

items.title: Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold Expansion Delayed to February 2027 - News
items.summary: Square Enix announced the Evercold expansion for Final Fantasy XIV has been delayed to February 23, 2027. Early Access will [...]
items.content:
Square Enix announced the Evercold expansion for Final Fantasy XIV has been delayed to February 23, 2027. Early Access will start four days earlier on February 19, 2027. Pre-orders will open on November 4.

A Collector's Edition will also be available. It includes a Reaper figure, Ethos metal keychain, Kottr mini plush, Tapestry of the Fourth, and an Evercold special art box.

Final Fantasy XIV is available for the Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, and PC via Steam .

items.title: Final Fantasy XIV Evercold Delayed, New Release Date Announced at FFXIV Fan Fest
items.summary: The MMORPG's next expansion was set to launch shortly after the new year, but Warriors of Light will have to wait a bit longer.
items.content:
Final Fantasy XIV Evercold was set to launch sometime in January 2027, which was announced as part of its initial reveal back in April this year during the North American FFXIV Fan Fest. However, this next expansion for the critically acclaimed MMORPG has been delayed – FFXIV Evercold's release date is now February 23, 2027 (and February 19, 2027 for early access). This was announced alongside the new, full trailer / intro cinematic for Evercold at FFXIV Fan Fest in Japan, and was said to only be a four-week delay.

In typical FFXIV fashion, the third and final teaser trailer is the full opening cinematic for an expansion, and it kicked off the Japan Fan Fest keynote where director and producer Naoki Yoshida presented more details on new features, where the ongoing story is headed, and fundemental gameplay changes as FFXIV goes into version 8.0 alongside Evercold's launch.

Pre-orders for Evercold open on November 4, 2026 and will come with a Wind-up Kottr minion to summon and follow you around in the world and Halone's Earring which will boost the EXP you gain for Jobs under level 100 when equipped. The collector's edition comes with the Valhallar Odin mount, the Entreat Crystal emote, and the Crystal Skyltborg which looks like glam for the new Bastion Job's weapons. The physical collector's bundle has the Evercold art book, the Tapestry of the Fourth decoration, a Kottr plush, a keychain of the Ethos Metal, and the Warrior of Light Reaper figure.

Additionally, we got a glimpse of the second new Job coming to his new expansion. It's a ranged DPS called Zephyr, which rocks a crossbow as their primary weapon and commands an avian companion to provide support.

There's a lot coming to FFXIV Evercold in addition to a new world and main story including a Neon Genesis Evangelion crossover raid series (which got a new teaser trailer) , a Final Fantasy VII crossover raid series, a new Tank Job with Bastion, and much more. Be sure to check out my Dawntrail review as well to look back at the last expansion before heading into this new era for FFXIV.

Michael is reviews editor at IGN and regularly contributes with previews, interviews, live events coverage, and news all in written and video form. He's usually entrusted with covering long RPGs and tech products, but he's got range when it comes to games. You'll also catch him at conventions and hosting video content, including IGN's weekly podcast Unlocked .

items.title: Final Fantasy XIV Evolves With Evercold In February 2027
items.summary: Final Fantasy XIV's Fan Festival in Tokyo is in full swing, and we now know we'll be heading to the Fourth in Evercold, come February 2027.
items.content:
Add us on Google Final Fantasy XIV ‘s world tour of Fan Festival events has reached its final destination in Japan, and producer Naoki Yoshida truly pulled back the curtain on Evercold in the opening keynote.

The next expansion was announced at the Fan Fest in Anaheim in April, and tentatively aimed to release in January. However, despite the team’s best efforts, Yoshida personally made the call to defer launch by a couple weeks. Early access for Final Fantasy XIV ‘s next era will begin on February 19, 2027, with the full proper release following on February 23. (Preorders, however, open next week on November 4.)

The third and final version of Evercold ‘s trailer debuted, showing the second new class being added in this expansion. This is a physical ranged DPS class dubbed Zephyr, where players will fight with a crossbow and “an avian familiar” called a Nephele. Starting at level 90, the Zephyr’s origins trace back to Ilsabard, and their playstyle is very mobile and evasive.

Yoshida then provided a glimpse at the new characters and settings that will feature as players journey to the Fourth. Alongside Visna, the new character with the Zephyr class, is a familiar person named Lagertha who looks an awful lot like Ysayle from Heavensward . Meanwhile it appears Alphinaud and Estinien are our only fellow Scions making the journey with us, while Halmarut and Calyx still have roles to play.

Evercold ‘s new areas revolve around the Realmships, massive airships that represent the elements and house the Fourth’s inhabitants, since the surface is covered in ice and inhabitable. Yoshida revealed the remaining Realmships—Sessrymnir, Realmship of Earth and Skidbladnir, Tealmship of Wind. The latter is where the Kettir cat-folk live, and Yoshida teased that their homeland upon the ship is “very, very, very” cute. In-universe, it’s been five hundred years since civilization took to the sky, and there’s been next to no contact between the Realmships, so each has evolved separately from there.

On the gameplay side, Yoshida ran through the changes coming to Final Fantasy XIV ‘s progression systems. As announced at the Anaheim Fan Fest in April, the MMORPG is shifting its focus from daily to weekly progression, to grant players the freedom to find their own pace or to avoid “punishing” people for not playing daily.

Updated mockups of the new Adventurer Activity screen were shown (see above), with Yoshida remarking that the room behind the character on this screen may be made customizable down the line. While it may resemble some paid season pass system, Yoshida vehemently promised that the game is not instituting “seasons” in terms of paid season passes, but simply as a means of tracking progress over updates. Completing repeatable or weekly missions (up to and including work on your Disciples of the Land or Hand classes) grants points that fill the meter on-screen. Once the meter hits the appropriate landmarks, players will receive rewards like gear and the specific means to upgrade that gear.

2 types of gear can be optimized each season through this menu. The first is Seasonal gear, which is intended for everyday players. Players obtain this tier by playing and raising their activity level. The second level is Raid gear, the best variety in the game. Raid gear will take more effort and resources, such as upgrades from new 8-player Savage-difficulty raids, but they offer customizable secondary abilities. Those who manage to fully optimize a complete, matching set will gain further enhancements.

Speaking of customization, Yoshida mentioned that the Evercold benchmark software will drop soon for PC players to test their machines and verify their settings. The built-in character creation tool will allow experimentation with the new appearance customizations tools detailed at Anaheim.

In one of the Keynote’s more shocking revelations, Yoshida announced a radical reconfiguration of the 24-player Alliance Raids. These specific trials will be split in half into separate duties, reducing how demanding they can be upon players’s time. Once a player has beaten the raid at least once, they can then choose to queue up for only their desired half if they’re seeking something specific. Plus, Yoshida pledged that “ the days of casting lots [for loot items] over and over, are over .”

Final Fantasy XIV will receive new battle content called the Gauntlet of Power, where parties do battle without level sync forcing players to go up or down to match the others. Instead, Square Enix’s new Auto Content Balancing system will adjust the difficulty of encounters to each players’ level, allowing them to participate at their level with all their hard-earned skills. The Gauntlet of Power is a dungeon boss rush mode, with up to 5 bosses challenged in secession. Opponents are picked based on the party’s individual progresses—meaning Final Fantasy XIV players need not fear having an upcoming boss being spoiled.

Those who use Final Fantasy XIV ‘s Duty Support feature often may be relieved to learn that the feature will now fill gaps in your party accordingly. Players can bring a friend or two in with them, and the computer will fill the remaining party slots. Other major updates planned for after Evercold ‘s launch include a Hall of the Novice for PvP, overhauls to housing, and the long-awaited adjustment for companion chcocobs.

Yoshida’s keystream culminated with further teases for Evercold ‘s big raid series. The first, a crossover with Final Fantasy VII called “Beyond the Lifestream,” will get its first installment in patch 8.0.1, and Yoshida showed off some original art by Tetsuya Nomura featuring Cloud, Sephiroth, and Final Fantasy XIV ‘s poster boy Warrior of Light.

The other raid series, Evangelion: Ghosts of Desire raid series kicks off in patch 8.1. Luckily this time Yoshida was able to show some actual footage, albeit it spliced to look and sound like an episode preview, narrated by Neon Genesis Evangelion ‘s Misato. It’s still surreal to consider the two properties crossing over in this way, but nonetheless, the next era is beginning to really shape up for Square Enix’s long-running MMORPG

items.title: Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold Delayed, Launching February 23, 2027
“ZEPHYR” UNVEILED AS SECOND NEW JOB FOR FINAL FANTASY XIV: EVERCOLD, SET TO RELEASE ON TUESDAY 23 rd FEBRUARY 2027
items.summary: Critically Acclaimed MMO Surpasses 35 Million Registered Accounts; Pre-order Information, New EVANGELION Series Crossover Trailer and More Revealed
items.content:
London (31 st October, 2026) – During the FINAL FANTASY XIV Fan Festival 2026 in Tokyo, SQUARE ENIX® announced that its critically acclaimed MMORPG FINAL FANTASY XIV Online has reached more than 35 million registered accounts globally and revealed new information about Evercold , the newest expansion set to release on Tuesday 23 rd February, 2027. During the opening keynote, Producer and Director Naoki Yoshida revealed “zephyr,” the second of two new jobs arriving in Evercold . A physical ranged DPS, zephyr joins the fray using a combination of crossbow shots and support from an avian familiar known as Nephele. A trailer showcasing the zephyr in action can be seen here: https://youtu.be/qX5jtcXjmts The keynote also introduced the full-length trailer for Evercold , which can be seen here: https://youtu.be/4qHEQ2CyOoA

Alongside the release date, Yoshida revealed that pre-orders for the Evercold expansion and the previously announced Collector’s Box will start beginning Wednesday 4 November. 2026 at 9:00 a.m. GMT. The Collector’s Bundle will be available for pre-order in limited quantities exclusively from the Square Enix Store and contains the physical Collector’s Box and a code for the FINAL FANTASY XIV: Evercold Digital Collector’s Edition for Windows® or Mac. PlayStation®5, PlayStation®4, XBOX Series X|S, Nintendo Switch™ 2 and Steam players can order the Collector’s Box as a standalone product and pre-order the Evercold Digital Collector’s Edition separately on their respective platforms. The Evercold Collector’s Box includes the physical goods listed below and does not include a copy of Evercold , in-game items, or pre-order bonuses.

For more information and the latest updates on Evercold , please visit the teaser site at: https://eu.finalfantasyxiv.com/evercold/ The keynote presentation (English language supported) is available to view on YouTube via the Fan Festival 2026 in Tokyo Day 1 live stream: https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2915321914?t=1h32m44s

With more than 35 million total registered accounts, there has never been a better time for newcomers to begin their adventures in the critically acclaimed FINAL FANTASY XIV Online saga. The Free Trial now contains all content from A Realm Reborn , Heavensward , Stormblood and Shadowbringers expansions up through patch 5.58. Free Trial players can enjoy hundreds of hours of award-winning gameplay and story experiences equivalent to four full FINAL FANTASY titles, without limit on playtime. More information can be found at: http://sqex.to/FFXIVFreeTrial Related Links Evercold Promotional Site: https://eu.finalfantasyxiv.com/evercold/ Official Player Site, The Lodestone: https://eu.finalfantasyxiv.com/lodestone Official Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/FinalFantasyXIV Official X: @FF_XIV_EN Official Instagram: @ffxiv Official Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/en.finalfantasyxiv.com YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@ffxiv Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/finalfantasyxiv #FFXIV About EVANGELION The television series NEON GENESIS EVANGELION became an immediate and widespread sensation upon its first broadcast in 1995. In 2007, the series was relaunched as the Rebuild of EVANGELION film series. Conceived, written and directed by Hideaki Anno, EVANGELION:1.0, 2.0 and 3.0 were all hugely successful, captivating new fans and garnering much praise from a wide range of audiences. The fourth and final film in the series, EVANGELION:3.0+1.0, was released on March 8, 2021, after having been postponed twice due to the COVID-19 pandemic. It recorded 6.73 million admissions, earning 10.2 billion yen at the box office. On March 8, 2023, the long-awaited Blu-ray and DVD, EVANGELION:3.0+1.11 THRICE UPON A TIME was released. October 2025 marked 30 years since the television series debuted, and a celebratory event titled EVANGELION:30+; 30th ANNIVERSARY OF EVANGELION was held in Yokohama Arena between February 21 and 23, 2026. Though such an anniversary event was a first for the series, it proved to be a resounding success, attracting a great many visitors from Japan and around the world. About FINAL FANTASY VII First released in 1997 on the PlayStation® computer entertainment system, FINAL FANTASY VII will celebrate its 30th anniversary in 2027. The game is universally regarded as a landmark title of the RPG genre. The original title received high praise for its epic storyline, unique characters, and movie sequences that utilized the most cutting-edge technology of the time. Since then, the game revolving around iconic hero Cloud Strife and his pursuit of the antagonist Sephiroth has sold over 15.7 million copies worldwide and continues to receive widespread acclaim from critics and fans around the world. The popular game has expanded into spin-offs, films and merchandise. Now, Square Enix’s FINAL FANTASY VII Remake Series, created by a team of original and new developers, retells the story of the genre-redefining RPG across three distinct games. The first game of the trilogy, FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE, is available for PS4® consoles. The expanded edition, FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE, and the second entry, FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH, are now available for Nintendo Switch 2, XBOX Series X|S, XBOX PC, PS5® consoles and PC. FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION, the climactic conclusion of the series, will release for PS5 consoles, Nintendo Switch 2, XBOX Series X|S and PC via Steam, Epic Games Store and XBOX PC, in Spring 2027. The Square Enix group of companies boasts a valuable portfolio of intellectual property including: FINAL FANTASY™, which has sold over 215 million units worldwide; DRAGON QUEST®, which has sold over 100 million units worldwide; and the legendary SPACE INVADERS®. items.title: Final Fantasy XIV Online's Sixth Expansion 'Evercold' Launches February 2027
items.summary: New job and much more revealed
items.content:
Now that the MMORPG Final Fantasy XIV Online is available on the Switch 2, Square Enix is looking towards the game's sixth expansion, Evercold .

We previously heard how it would be coming in January 2027, and now at the Final Fantasy XIV Fan Fest in Tokyo this weekend, Square Enix has announced the date has been shifted to 23rd February 2027 . Pre-orders will begin on 4th November 2026 , with early access opening on 19th February 2027 .

As previously confirmed, it will come with new jobs, cities, areas, dungeons, trials, new areas, a level cap increase and much more. Joining the Bastion job is the new physical ranged DPS, Zephyr. You can find out more about what's included in Evercold in our previous story and on the FFXIV YouTube channel .

Keybound Brawler, a new event that tests your typing prowess, is coming to the Manderville Gold Saucer! The first iteration of the event will be a special collaboration with the FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE series. Participate in the collaboration stages to obtain MGC which can be exchanged for numerous rewards, including collaboration attire, a mount, emote, and more!

Event Duration

From Wednesday, October 28, 2026 at 1:00 a.m. (PDT) / 8:00 (GMT) / 19:00 (AEDT) to the release of Patch 8.0 * The end date listed on Steam does not reflect the release date for Patch 8.0.

How to Participate

Begin the quest "Keyward Bound" by speaking to the Catlike Mammet in The Gold Saucer (X:5.4 Y:7.0). * Players must be level 15 and above to start the quest. * Players must first complete one of the following main scenario quests: "The Gridanian Envoy," "The Ul'dahn Envoy," or "The Lominsan Envoy." * Players must first complete the quest "It Could Happen to You" to be able to travel to the Manderville Gold Saucer via airship from any of the three city-states. * Please note that a keyboard is required to participate in this content. Gamepads and on-screen keyboards cannot be used.

Rewards

* After this collaboration event has ended, it will be held as a special event at irregular intervals. Visit the special site for more details.
